description: Double-negation, De Morgan, implication-as-disjunction and quantifier-duality rewrites, together with negation of falsity or truth, preserve exactly the free-variable sets.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.negation_identities_support.{u, v, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {α : Type u'} {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq α] (φ ψ : L.BoundedFormula α n) (θ : L.BoundedFormula α (n + 1)) :
  φ.not.not.freeVarFinset = φ.freeVarFinset ∧
    (φ ⊓ ψ).not.freeVarFinset = (φ.not ⊔ ψ.not).freeVarFinset ∧
      (φ ⊔ ψ).not.freeVarFinset = (φ.not ⊓ ψ.not).freeVarFinset ∧
        (φ.imp ψ).freeVarFinset = (φ.not ⊔ ψ).freeVarFinset ∧
          θ.all.not.freeVarFinset = θ.not.ex.freeVarFinset ∧
            θ.ex.not.freeVarFinset = θ.not.all.freeVarFinset ∧
              ⊥.not.freeVarFinset = ⊤.freeVarFinset ∧ ⊤.not.freeVarFinset = ⊥.freeVarFinset
